Fine weather for flying. It's times like these that make me miss it all.
Your travels been going all right?
{pilot lingo - means watch your back} Watch your six out there.

topics.prompt: What do you do in Novac?

responses.text: "For?" No, not exactly. It was a long time ago. Things are a lot different these days, and those days are way behind me.

topics.prompt: Did you fly for the NCR?

responses.text: Told you everything about us, did he? Well, it's been a while since I've had my hands on the controls of a vertibird.
There's a chance I could crash us in the middle of Lake Mead - that place seems to attract aircraft, for some reason.
But, if I'll get one more chance to fly, count me in. I'll be there. My part of the pass phrase is "Dear."

topics.prompt: Arcade asked me to find you. I'm reuniting the Remnants, and they'll need your piloting skills.

responses.text: Well, anyway, Judah's given Orion's armor to you now. It'll take a few hours for me to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.

topics.prompt: I'm sorry I had to kill him - he didn't give me much choice.

responses.text: Yeah, he did.

topics.prompt: Doesn't matter - he paid for his mistake.

responses.text: Right. Moving on, then.
{nostalgia} I never was happier than when I was in the cockpit. I was able to go just about anywhere and everywhere, limited only by the fuel I could carry.
There were more than a few missions where I took the scenic route home just so I could stay in the air. Caught hell for it every time, but worth it!
{more sober, slightly defensive} Some of the things we did were questionable, I know. That's just how it was back then. Figure I've done enough good to make up for any sins, anyhow.
